title: Commercial Drones Quietly Overtook Hobby Drones
hook: 453,635 commercial drones now outnumber hobby models.
closing: The sky shifted from hobby space toward business infrastructure faster than most people noticed.
question: Ever flown a drone yourself?

segments.say: Commercial drones reached 453,635 registrations, overtaking recreational models and turning a hobby boom into an industry.
Registered drones reached 837,513, putting more unmanned aircraft into shared airspace than ever before.
New drone registrations slowed to 10,500 monthly, showing the boom is cooling after commercialization won.
